The '''RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tank''', also known simply as the '''stun tank''', was a mobile [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] artillery [[Tank/Legends|tank]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:Stun_tanks_on_Coruscant.png|thumb|left|250px|''Falchion''-class assault tanks attacking the Zillo Beast on Coruscant]]
Somewhat resembling the larger [[Self-Propelled Heavy Artillery|SPHA-T]], the tank was used to provide anti-aircraft fire against [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] during the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]]. They were largely successful but for the fact that since the tank carried a stun cannon unlike their larger predecessors, the enemy fighters, drained of all their power, crashed into the Republic forces and disabled at least three [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]]. They were later used to disable the [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], awakened in a sink hole created by the detonation of an [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]] during the battle, but most of the tanks were destroyed by the enraged monster.<ref name="TZB" /> A number of the tanks were also used during the [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|Zillo Beast incident]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which occurred during the rampage of the escaped creature.<ref name="ZBS" />
